input.free_text_description: This system is a messaging platform that serves Admin, User roles. It manages core business objects including chat room, chat message. The platform provides capabilities for stomp handler, redis subscriber, chat room repository. The system includes access control and identity verification to protect resources and manage sessions. Secondary concerns include microservices functionality.

user_stories.story: As a User, I want to securely sign in to the system, so that I can access my personalized resources.
As a Admin, I want to create and manage chat room records, so that I can track and organize chat room data effectively.
As a Admin, I want to create and manage chat message records, so that I can track and organize chat message data effectively.
As a Admin, I want to interact with index functionality, so that I can accomplish my index-related tasks.
As a Admin, I want to use stomp handler capabilities, so that I can perform essential business operations.
